# Quotation -- Technical maintenance services, Rautavaara industrial estate (TKR-RFQ-2026-07)

**Bidder:** Visakoivu Oy, Jyvaskyla

## 2. Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds a valid LUSA qualification (LVI- ja sahkourakointi, valid to 2027-03-31) and a valid F-gas regulation qualification (valid to 2028-01-31), covering the refrigeration and air-conditioning maintenance required at the estate. The company employs 62 LVI professionals and 48 electrical professionals in its own workforce, both above the stated minimums of 20 and 15. A current Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate is held (valid to 2026-12-31). The qualifying reference is the Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue framework agreement, EUR 1,650,000, five health centres, 2021-2024.

## 3. Technical requirements

**3.1 Occupational safety plan:** Operated under NMSB 75310:2018, with a site-specific safety plan for work across the four-building estate, covering induction, PPE and permit-to-work.

**3.2 Warranty period:** 24 months on installed equipment and materials.

**3.3 Lift maintenance:** Statutory inspection and maintenance of the estate's goods and passenger lifts met and documented through our lift-partner arrangement.

**3.4 Waste management:** Waste generated during maintenance sorted and managed in accordance with site requirements.

**3.5 Spare parts:** Common parts typically available within a few working days; discontinued equipment assessed for equivalent substitution.

**3.6 Quality control:** Inspection and sign-off under NMSB 7310:2015 for all completed work.

**3.7 Environmental management:** Managed under NMSB 74210:2015, covering emissions, noise and waste during works.

**3.8 Building envelope inspection:** Scheduled condition assessment of roofing, cladding and fabric across Halli 1-4, with a written report to the Buyer.

**3.9 Maintenance visit scheduling:** Visit content and frequency set per system criticality and building, agreed with the estate manager in advance.

**3.10 Access and security:** Site access coordinated with each tenant's own security procedures, respecting the 48-hour notice period in Liite A except in emergencies.

**3.11 Reporting:** Maintenance activity and outstanding items reported to the Buyer's facilities contact on a regular schedule.

**3.12 Response and on-call:** Response tiered by severity, with 24/7 on-call cover for shared-system critical faults.

**3.13 Asset register handover:** Existing asset register and documentation reviewed and maintained under our system from contract start.

**3.14 Corrective maintenance response:** Non-emergency requests addressed within an agreed window by severity category.

**3.15 Staff training:** Annual training for the Buyer's facilities staff on maintained systems.

**3.16 Subcontracting management:** Subcontracted trades selected against our approved-supplier register and supervised by our site lead.

**3.17 Escalation:** Unresolved faults escalated to the maintenance manager where the agreed response time is exceeded, with the Buyer informed.

## 4. Commercial terms

**4.1 Bonus-malus:** Arrangement proposed for over- and under-performance against agreed service levels.
**4.2 Price indexation:** Annual adjustment against an agreed index, reference month confirmed at signature.
**4.3 Payment terms:** Terms in this request and its annexes accepted in accordance with the stated conditions.
**4.4 Invoicing:** Monthly, electronic invoicing capability confirmed.
**4.5 Termination:** 30 days' written notice for uncured material breach.
**4.6 Pricing structure:** Shared-system maintenance priced in EUR per square metre per year, per Liite B.3, not per month.
**4.7 Currency:** All prices in euro.

## 5. Enclosures

Reference form (Liite 2), certificate of pension insurance payments, certificate of tax payment, description of the quality system -- all enclosed.

## 6. Format

Minimum 11pt font throughout. Delivery channel and number of copies stated in the covering letter. Closing date and time noted: 16 October 2026, 14:00 Finnish time (EET/EEST as applicable). Framework pricing in euro. Monetary figures rounded to two decimal places.

## Annex A

Personnel qualifications and site-induction requirements confirmed for all estate-based staff. Method statement provided for installation work minimising disruption to tenants' operations. F-gas-regulated maintenance confirmed for refrigeration equipment. HVAC maintenance scope and frequency set per building. Continuity of service maintained through cross-trained staff per discipline. Periodic electrical inspection programme confirmed across the estate. Fire protection testing and maintenance scheduled per building.

## Annex B

Discount structure proposed for increasing order volumes. Contractual penalty for service-level shortfall accepted in principle, terms to be finalised. Pricing for shared-system maintenance quoted at EUR per square metre per year, as required by B.3, not EUR per month. Quoted prices valid for 90 days from the closing date.
